checks.text: The page shows the heading "Wheel Spinner" and the text "No entries yet" in the entries list area.
Typing "Alice" in the field labelled "Entry name" and clicking the button "Add entry" adds a list item containing "Alice" and the text "No entries yet" is gone.
After adding "Alice" and "Bob", clicking the button "Spin" shows a result banner with the text "Winner: Alice" or "Winner: Bob" (one of the two entries).
After a spin result is shown, clicking the button "Copy result" copies the text "Winner: Alice" or "Winner: Bob" to the clipboard, matching the current result banner text.
Clicking the tab "History" shows a table with the header "Spin log" and at least one row containing the winner name from the last spin and a timestamp.
With "Alice" and "Bob" in the list, clicking the button "Delete Bob" removes the "Bob" list item, leaving only "Alice" in the entries list.
After adding "Alice" and "Bob", clicking the button "Reset all" clears the entries list to show "No entries yet" and clears the History table to show "No spins yet".
Typing "Carol" in the field labelled "Entry name" and clicking "Add entry" with "Alice" already present adds a second list item containing "Carol", so the list shows both "Alice" and "Carol".
Reload keeps the entry "Alice" in the entries list and the spin log row in the History tab after a spin was performed.
